product.name: 01 Content workflow
product.description: Ty-controlled workflow: Not Started, Draft, Ready for Review, or Approved. Only Approved owner content is eligible for storefront and future Snoozer use.

product.name: 02 Product knowledge category
product.description: Category-specific contract assigned to this product.

product.description: Version of the normalized MySnoozePod product-knowledge contract.

product.name: 04 Technical content status
product.description: Verification status for structured technical facts.

product.name: 05 Technical source and provenance
product.description: Machine-readable provenance for technical facts. Do not use this field for customer-facing prose.

product.name: 06 Assortment status
product.description: Owner assortment decision, separate from Shopify publication status.

product.name: 07 Publication readiness
product.description: Independent operational publication gate.

product.name: 08 Internal model

product.name: 10 Showroom representation
product.description: Structured physical showroom display, sample, or swatch relationship.

product.name: 11 Internal comfort options
product.description: Verified technical comfort identifiers. Customer labels require an approved mapping.

product.name: 12 Configuration readiness
product.description: Whether exact purchasable configuration mappings are verified.

product.description: Ty-authored opening description. Visible only when the content workflow is Approved.

product.description: Customer-facing benefit statements approved by Ty.

product.description: Ty-authored explanation of meaningful product distinctions.

product.description: Ty-authored assortment rationale.
